name: espn-fantasy-football
description: Format-aware fantasy-football analysis of your own ESPN league: a local, read-only MCP server plus decision Skills.

league_id.title: ESPN league id
league_id.description: The numeric leagueId from your ESPN league's URL. Kept in your Claude Code settings on this machine only.

season.title: Season (ESPN_SEASON)
season.description: Leave empty to read the current NFL season, the one the eff CLI and the scheduled jobs read. A year pins this plugin's server to that season only.

toolset.title: Toolset (EFF_TOOLSET)
toolset.description: full registers all 34 read tools, which the five P1 Skills need; core registers the 18 P0 tools. Empty: config.json's EFF_TOOLSET, else core. Restart the client after a change.
